_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "signature_path" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "rfc" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_name" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "areas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plants (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_models" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "dpi" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "printers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "qr_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "serial_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "plant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plants (id), "area_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES areas (id), "model_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_models (id), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_label_types" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "printer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES printers (id), "tech_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "service_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "service_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "linear_inches_counter" INTEGER NOT NULL, "darkness_level" INTEGER NULL, "label_type_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES catalog_label_types (id), "technical_checkboxes" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "signature_name" TEXT NULL, "signature_role" TEXT NULL, "internal_notes" TEXT NULL, "supersedes_report_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES reports (id), "photo_paths" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "photo_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "signature_image_path" TEXT NULL, "signature_block_id" TEXT NULL, "report_block_status" TEXT NULL, "pending_email" TEXT NULL, "assignment_override" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("assignment_override" IN (0, 1)), "code" TEXT NULL, "sync_date" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_actions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "report_actions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "report_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports (id), "action_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_actions (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_parts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "report_parts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "report_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports (id), "part_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_parts (id), "was_damaged" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("was_damaged" IN (0, 1)), "wear_level" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "policies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id), "folio" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "coverage_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "sla_notes" TEXT NULL, "frequency_maintenance" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "policy_printers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "policy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES policies (id), "printer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES printers (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "policy_deliveries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "policy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES policies (id), "delivery_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "signature_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "signature_role" TEXT NOT NULL, "tech_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "signature_image_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "policy_delivery_reports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "delivery_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES policy_deliveries (id), "report_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "policy_visits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "policy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES policies (id), "visit_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scheduled_date" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled', "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "policy_printer_assignments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "policy_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES policies (id), "printer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES printers (id), "technician_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "assigned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "files" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_files" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files (id), "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_category" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_failures" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_queue" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "method_http" TEXT NOT NULL, "endpoint_destino" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha_creacion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "estado_peticion" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "intentos_fallidos" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
